svg.aria-label: How I work. Read the real system first. The ERP, the time clock, the spreadsheet being replaced: all of it, before any design. Small commits. A median of 2 files each, so a change can be read and undone. Tests before every commit. Nothing goes in while a test is red. Agents as teammates. Claude Code and Codex, with skills and hooks I write and measure. github.com/SabillonJ. Updated 12 Oct 2026.
